[[Image:AzureFlame.png|right|160px]]
'''Azure Flame''' is a [[magical effect]] type of [[special]] card.  It first appeared in [[The King in Yellow]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': Magical effect

'''Bonus''': +4 to [[Combat check]]s

'''Any phase''':  When using the Azure Flame in [[Combat]], all 6's rolled count as 2 successes.

Discard this card if your [[Call the Azure Flame]] is refreshed or leaves your possession.

'''Hands''': 2
